# Psalm 66 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** For-the-choirmaster. A-song. A-psalm. Shout-for-joy to-God, all the-earth!

**2** Sing the-glory of-His-name; make glorious His-praise.

**3** Say to-God, 'How awesome [are] Your-works! Because-of the-greatness of-Your-power, Your-enemies cringe before-You.

**4** All the-earth bows-down to-You and-sings-praise to-You; they-sing-praise to-Your-name.' Selah.

**5** Come and-see the-works of-God — awesome [is His] doing toward the-sons of-man.

**6** He-turned the-sea to-dry-land; through-the-river they-passed on-foot. There we-rejoiced in-Him.

**7** He-rules by-His-might forever; His-eyes keep-watch on-the-nations. The-rebellious — let-them-not exalt-themselves. Selah.

**8** Bless our-God, O-peoples, and-make-heard the-voice of-His-praise,

**9** the-One-setting our-soul in-life, and-not giving our-foot to-slip.

**10** For You-have-tested-us, O-God; You-have-refined-us as-the-refining of-silver.

**11** You-brought-us into-the-net; You-placed a-burden on-our-loins.

**12** You-let-man ride over-our-head; we-went through-fire and-through-water, but-You-brought-us-out to-abundance.

**13** I-come to-Your-house with-burnt-offerings; I-pay to-You my-vows,

**14** which my-lips uttered and-my-mouth spoke in-my-distress.

**15** Burnt-offerings of-fatlings I-offer to-You, with-the-smoke of-rams; I-prepare cattle with-male-goats. Selah.

**16** Come, hear, all-you who-fear God, and-I-will-recount what He-has-done for-my-soul.

**17** To-Him my-mouth cried-out, and-praise [was] under my-tongue.

**18** If I-had-regarded iniquity in-my-heart, the-Lord would-not have-heard.

**19** But-indeed God has-heard; He-has-attended to-the-voice of-my-prayer.

**20** Blessed [is] God, who has-not turned-away my-prayer, and-His-steadfast-love from-me.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **66:18**: 'If I had regarded iniquity in my heart' — unconfessed sin blocks prayer. The psalmist's prayer was heard because his heart was clean.

— EMET
